recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, low-angle group portrait of five men in 1970s rock attire (denim, leather, bandanas) standing in front of a weathered urban storefront with vintage signage. The image features high-contrast lighting, visible film grain, and a mix of aggressive hand-drawn logotype and casual script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Band members grouped tightly in the foreground against a receding urban background
Aggressive, sharp-angled logo contrasting with the organic, casual poses of the subjects
Primary color accents (yellow shirt, red bandana) breaking a dominant blue-grey denim palette
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' stature
Weathered, hand-painted storefront signage in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the bright yellow shirt acts as a chromatic anchor amidst darker tones.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sharp white logo top-left, move down through the band members' faces, and settle on the colored script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space, primarily located in the dark upper-right corner and the pavement at the bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Indigo and charcoal (denim and leather textures)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale yellow (background signage and central shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary red and cyan (bottom text and bandana)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated background tones allow the high-value white logo and saturated accents to pop.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy, film-like color processing

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Aggressive italicized script and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top logo: Sharp, lightning-bolt-like terminals, heavy italic slant, double-stroke outline effect
Bottom text: Casual, monolinear brush script with rounded terminals and natural handwriting flow
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 's' in the top logo feature extended, jagged horizontal strokes that frame the word
The 't' in the top logo has a crossbar that merges with the surrounding letter strokes

composition.overlap: partially over background and subject hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, sharp custom lettering paired with a soft, friendly brush script for contrast.

preserve: Jagged terminals of the top logo
Hand-written feel of the bottom text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Action Script or Speed Metal fonts
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, jagged energy of the top logo
Matches the informal, handwritten quality of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy 35mm film photograph of five men in 1970s rock band attire standing in front of a vintage urban storefront at dusk. High contrast, deep shadows, and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, jagged custom script logo in the top left with lightning-bolt terminals. Add a smaller, two-tone (cyan and red) casual brush script at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Does the top logo have sharp, aggressive terminals?
Is the film grain visible and consistent across the image?
Are the colors in the bottom text cyan and red?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the top logo slant
Degree of weathering on the background storefront
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the band members
Exact wording of the background signage
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the logo does not look like a standard computer font
Check that the grain doesn't obscure facial expressions
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the color accents are distinct but not overwhelming
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty, low-angle group portrait with aggressive, jagged custom lettering at the top and casual brush script at the bottom, all processed with heavy film grain and high contrast.
